value.rationale: Finite-size probabilities along a typical-leaf path in the critical beta-splitting tree are a natural target. The positive mixture upgrades established first-order descent to an infinite hierarchy of strict moment inequalities, and a useful two-sided convergence envelope valid for all growing or fixed target indices. This is an exact structural finite-size theorem, not a small numerical gain or a reformulation of a known limiting coefficient.
